acceptance.description: `python -m ruff check .` exits 0 at the repo root
tests/conftest.py isolates APPLYPILOT_DIR (config.APP_DIR/DB_PATH under a temp dir, not ~/.applypilot) and unsets CHROME_PATH; pyproject dev extras include pytest and ruff
ci.yml triggers on push and pull_request; lint step runs `ruff check .` (not src/); test step runs pytest on tests/ with PYTHONPATH=src
unchanged: matrix keeps Python 3.11/3.12/3.13; no continue-on-error and no `|| true`

with a stubbed scrape_jobs, search_jobs and _full_crawl with sites=None pass site_name ['indeed','zip_recruiter'] (no linkedin, no linkedin_fetch_description); explicitly configured linkedin is dropped; searches.example.yaml boards has no linkedin and keeps indeed/glassdoor/zip_recruiter/google

is_linkedin_url host semantics; store_jobspy_results, database.store_jobs and workday.store_results skip rows whose URL or application URL is on LinkedIn and store only the non-LinkedIn row (temp SQLite DB)

CLI `apply --url <linkedin>` (with and without --gen) exits 1 with 'LinkedIn job URLs are not supported: <url>' before the DB is created; launcher.main and gen_prompt raise LinkedInBlockedError; worker_loop marks a queued LinkedIn job failed/linkedin_blocked/99 and returns (0, 0); launch_chrome, run_job and subprocess.Popen are never called

doctor prints a status line for Python, Chrome/Chromium, Node.js, Claude Code CLI, Database, Job sources; run_checks order; Chrome MISSING when get_chrome_path raises; Node MISSING below 18, when absent and with PATH=''; Python 3.11+ check; Database MISSING/OK without creating the file; Job sources note without linkedin
harness written with the tests: fixture_form_server serves tests/fixtures/forms/basic_form.html from 127.0.0.1; it has a form with text input, file input and submit button and no external resources
README has '## Fork notice' mentioning fork, ApplyPilot, https://github.com/Pickle-Pixel/ApplyPilot and AGPL-3.0
unchanged: README keeps '## License' (GNU AGPL v3.0) and the Pickle-Pixel attribution

docs/traceability.md table '| Requirement | Description | Tests |' has rows for FR-DIS-2, SAF-4, FR-CLI-2, NFR-1, NFR-10, NFR-11, each naming existing paths under tests/; NFR-1 and NFR-11 also name .github/workflows/ci.yml

untestable.reason: The part 'PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest tests/ exits 0' cannot be asserted from inside the suite itself (it would recurse). The verify stage's full test run checks it.
